title: Pickleball Smash
style: 1970s jazz swing big band with a jaunty midtempo bounce and female vocals; brushed drums and upright bass drive the groove while brass punches answer each line, trumpet breaks trade with Spanish guitar licks, and the verses stay tight and playful. Pre-chorus lifts with stacked harmonies and a cymbal push, chorus hits with shouty gang vocals and call-and-response. Warm horn-forward mix, bright and alive, with tape-sweet brass sparkle., jazz, swing, big band, pop
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Michelle, mishy mish mash,
pickle ball smash.
Hit by a black truck,
right leg took a whack.
Can’t run, baby, can’t run,
but I still move that way.
I can walk to the line,
I can make my play.

[Pre-Chorus]
Tennis pro, now watch me,
turn it into gold.
Short steps, soft hands,
keep the kitchen cold.
Eyes up, stay low,
let the ball talk back.
One clean touch,
then I send it crack.

[Chorus]
Michelle, mishy mish mash,
pickle ball smash.
Bee bop, bee bop,
pop that shot.
Michelle, mishy mish mash,
pickle ball smash.
One more dink,
then I pop that shot.

[Verse 2]
I read that backhand,
I read that spin.
Feather it over,
let the point begin.
Bend at the knees,
don’t chase too hard.
Win with the brain
and a little guard.
Drop it short,
make them reach.
Then I roll that crosscourt
right past their feet.

[Pre-Chorus]
Tennis pro, now watch me,
turn it into gold.
Short steps, soft hands,
keep the kitchen cold.
Eyes up, stay low,
let the ball talk back.
One clean touch,
then I send it crack.

[Chorus]
Michelle, mishy mish mash,
pickle ball smash.
Bee bop, bee bop,
pop that shot.
Michelle, mishy mish mash,
pickle ball smash.
One more dink,
then I pop that shot.

[Bridge]
Right leg aching,
but I’m still in the game.
Lean on the left side,
bring the heat and fame.
Not fast, just smart,
that’s the way I win.
One last flick of the wrist—
watch it drop in.

[Final Chorus]
Michelle, mishy mish mash,
pickle ball smash.
Bee bop, bee bop,
pop that shot.
Michelle, mishy mish mash,
pickle ball smash.
Walk it in clean,
then I pop that shot.
